Between 2014 and 2017, Iraq fought a military campaign against the Islamic State of Iraq and ash-Sham (ISIS) to recapture territory the group seized in 2014.

spans.text: The COR approved most of the cabinet ministers, marking the transition to Iraq's first constitutional government in nearly a half-century.
The COR approved Mohammad Shia' al-SUDANI as prime minister in 2022.
Iraq's constitution also established the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG), a semi-autonomous region that administers the governorates of Erbil, Dahuk, and As Sulaymaniyah.
